generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All materials shall be of good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.
The rates of all the items appeared in Bill of Quantities are inclusive of all leads and lifts

The tenderer should quote his rates With all leads and lifts loading and un loading, including cost of Labour, hire charges of Machinery and other incidental charges etc complete as per the directions of the engineer incharge of the work specifications.

Defect liability period of 1 year and 1 year for major repairs to be considered.(Maintenance date starts from the date of completion period.) All the items included in the estimate are inclusive of lead and lift charges.
The work will be inspected by the third party & the bill will be admitted only after the satisfactory quality report from third party.
It is to be noted that any false documentation is found to be uploaded, the action may attract punitive measures such as blacklisting, cancellation of registration etc.
The Information on litigation in which the tender is involved are to be furnished
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
Acceptence Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same
Addendums/Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
All Material Test Report submitted
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work
The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer , not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer, RDW&S, Gadag is final
The work is subjected to Third Party Inspection and inspection by other Govt agencies Third Party agency is appointed by theDepartment empaneled by Chief Engineer RWD and S Bangalore
All Conditions As per Bid Document
